citation_status_definition.corpus_self_reference: cites the IndicRecipeNutri KG itself (unstated pre-0.10.0 version)
citation_status_definition.descriptive_genre: the upstream names a genre or gives its own descriptive basis; title holds that wording verbatim and is not a work title
citation_status_definition.none_recorded: unsourced rule; search_recorded preserves the upstream's failed search
citation_status_definition.resolved: has a url, identifier or title taken verbatim from the upstream cell
citation_status_definition.unresolved: only a publisher/site is named; the specific work cannot be identified from the row

citation detail with no frozen column: document dates other than access date
schemeless web addresses are kept in `locator`, never promoted to `url`

rules.yaml.meta.prevalence_source: dropped; Pew 2021 may appear only as a citation (role prevalence_reference), never with percentages

g09_self_check.note: titles are quoted in their source cells as titles, not as text quotations; a literal G-09 will match them unless citation titles are exempted

licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (destination LICENSE-DATA); upstream source S1 CC BY 4.0 attribution retained; licensor statement of H. Y. Badgujar, 2026-09-23
link_policy: exact = lower-cased source_occasion_id or name (registry) / rule name (rules) equals the node key; no alias rows are generated (none reviewed); >1 candidate -> ambiguous, unresolved; reviewed_by/reviewed_on are null because no human review was performed
not_executed: Rule predicates were imported as data and were not executed against any recipe.
or_04_rule: unlocatable rows must be single_source or needs_gazette (OR-04 as amended by the dataset owner, 2026-09-23)
personal_observance: No column describes a person; religion/scope/states_observed/standing_for_religions describe an occasion's or rule's tradition.
